Class DynamicDataAnalyzerImpl

java.lang.Object
dataAnalysis.DynamicDataAnalyzerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
DynamicDataAnalyzer
Direct Known Subclasses:
QuantileDataAnalyzer
public class DynamicDataAnalyzerImpl extends Object implements DynamicDataAnalyzer
Dynamic data analyzer of the JSIM engine. It removes the initial transient of the measured samples using the R5 heuristic [Fis73] and the MSER-5 stationarity rule [Spr98], and then generates the confidence intervals with the spectral method [HW81], as described in the JSIM chapters of the JMT user manual.

In detail, this class can remove the initial transient period and performs calculation of variance and confidence interval of the sample mean of a sequence.
It is robust to data correlation.

See:
(1) K. Pawlikowski, "Steady­State Simulation of Queueing Processes: A Survey of Problems and Solutions", ACM Computing Surveys 22, 2 (1990), pp. 122--170

    • calcVar

      public double calcVar(double[] data, int start, int n, int K, int polyOrder)
      calculates the variance through Heidelberger & Welch method, if the data are the means of batches of size batchLen, the variance must be multiplied by batchLen.
      Parameters:
      data - array containing the sequence of data
      start - the starting sample
      n - number of data of the sequence to be estimated
      K - number of points used in the polynomial fitting must be <= n/4, typically is 25, 50
      polyOrder - the order of the polynomial to be fitted to the getLog of the spectrum of data typically is 2 or 3.
      Returns:
      the estimated variance

    • calcConstants

      public double[] calcConstants(int K, int polyOrder)
      computes the degrees of freedom of the tStudent distribution used in the estimation of variance and confidence intervals C2, and a constant used to depolarize the variance estimator
      Parameters:
      K - number of points of the polyfit
      polyOrder - the order of the polynomial
      Returns:
      the double array of dimension 2, at first position it is C1 and at second C2
